method: 100 axial section length-weighted centroids per shaft, tracked from cranial to caudal. Review stations measured from current surfaces, not original authoring centrelines. Receiver spur is represented by an exact shared-rim reference.

structures.limitations: Shaft guide only; common exterior receiver spur is specified by its shared boundary. Cranial and caudal caps are not drainage joins.
